name: Brewnall Village
summary: Brewnall Village sits in Chill Breeze Valley, near the entrance to Gnomeregan. The Barleybrew family keeps this dwarven camp for brewing experiments and defense against wild beasts.

sections.title: A Bitter Brew in the Valley
sections.body: Brewnall Village shelters the Barleybrew clan in Chill Breeze Valley, among the gnomish reaches of western Dun Morogh. The dwarven brewers work to perfect old recipes and make the finest stout. Tents and brewing gear fill the camp, with no permanent stone buildings. The Barleybrews test new ales while wolves and bears threaten the valley. Wandering mountaineers help gather rare ingredients and keep the area safe.

faq.answer: Brewnall Village is a dwarven camp in Chill Breeze Valley, in western Dun Morogh, just east of Gnomeregan. The Barleybrew clan experiments with beer recipes there and contends with local wildlife.

faq.q: Why is it called a village if there are no buildings?
faq.answer: Brewnall Village is an open-air camp of tents and supply kegs, rather than stone houses. The Barleybrews brew in the cold valley without building permanent homes.

faq.q: Why is a dwarven settlement located in gnomish territory?
faq.answer: The Barleybrews settled in Chill Breeze Valley, where gnomes live near Gnomeregan. Ironforge and the gnomes are close allies, and the dwarves pursue their brewing craft here undisturbed.

faq.q: What problems do the residents face?
faq.answer: Aggressive wildlife threatens the camp, including crag boars, bears, and frost wolves. The Barleybrews also seek rare ingredients for new and better brews.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see the Barleybrews' pursuit of the finest recipe as an honorable craft rooted in Ironforge tradition.
Near Gnomeregan, you find a dwarven camp deep in the gnomish valleys of western Dun Morogh.
